mods.name: Armor HUD
mods.description: Your armor beside the hotbar, each piece's own icon over its durability bar, shaking when it is hit, with your shield beside it; and above the hearts, your armor points, toughness, and a bar showing how many hearts a big hit would leave you.

releases.notes:
- Each worn piece shows as its own icon beside the hotbar, stacked head to foot, dye, trim and shimmer included.
- Under each icon, its durability bar, green to red, flashing when it is nearly broken.
- A piece that takes a hit shakes and flashes; one that breaks leaves its slot flashing red.
- A shield in the offhand sits beside the boots with its own durability bar, in place of vanilla's offhand slot.
- Above the hearts, in place of vanilla's chestplates: armor points, toughness, and a bar over your hearts showing how many a full-health hit would leave you.
- Protection enchantments count toward it.
